title: publish-release.sh closing checklist still describes the pre-Article-3 flow (latest moved, README read-back, marketplace at publish)
description: Observed on the lore 0.11.0 release-candidate staging run (2026-09-27, 04:07-04:12Z). After a release-candidate-only publish, scripts/publish-release.sh still prints a closing checklist written for the old flow: it tells the operator to read back the README (the npm package-level readme follows latest, which did not move), to cut the GitHub Release, and to tell quest-cli "lore is live (latest moved)" and opum-marketplace the skills tree SHA. Under Article 3.5 all of that belongs AFTER scripts/promote-latest.mjs moves latest, not after staging. The script summary line itself is correct ("latest is NOT moved here"). Relatedly, the script registry-state table read the root launcher as ABSENT because of propagation lag, while its own later visibility poll and smoke found it; the table should be taken after the visibility gate. Pairs with LCLI-616 (the README read-back placement in release.yml).

acceptanceCriteria.text: After a release-candidate stage, publish-release.sh prints only the steps that apply before the final latest publish and points at the final-publish step (LCLI-621) for the rest; a test pins the closing text

The final-publish step (LCLI-621: promote-latest.mjs or its successor), or the runbook item it cites, carries the post-latest checklist: README read-back (packument readme non-empty), GitHub Release, downstream notices, LCLI-469 handshake, release-truth record
The registry-state table is printed after the visibility gate, so a lagging root launcher is not reported ABSENT; bun test and bun run lore check exit 0

implementationNotes: RE-SCOPED 2026-09-27 on opum-agent's OPAG-474 ruling (cross-session; OPAG-474 read at opum-agent origin/dev 5e84561e). Under the narrow Article 3.5 amendment the post-latest checklist follows the final @opum-ai/lore X publish to latest (LCLI-621), not a dist-tag move, so AC1 and AC2 now point there. HELD until the amendment is ratified in opum-doc. Depends on LCLI-621.
UNHELD 2026-09-27 with LCLI-616 (same branch feat/LCLI-616-618-post-latest-readback), on opum-agent's direction after LCLI-621 landed.
